summary.zh-CN: 新建或修改技能时自动使用，按固定流程查重、编写并保存成待确认草案。
summary.en: Used automatically when creating or revising a skill: checks for duplicates, writes the skill and saves it as a draft for confirmation.

modifications.zh-CN: 技能名改为 teloa-skill-creator，说明改为 Teloa 场景。
modifications.en: Renamed to teloa-skill-creator and rewrote the description for Teloa.

modifications.zh-CN: 删除 agents/openai.yaml 相关段落；未收录 agents/openai.yaml、references/openai_yaml.md 与 scripts/ 下三个 Python 脚本。
modifications.en: Removed the agents/openai.yaml guidance; agents/openai.yaml, references/openai_yaml.md and the three Python scripts under scripts/ are not included.

modifications.zh-CN: 用「Teloa 创建流程」替换原初始化与校验步骤：先查重，再保存成待确认草案。
modifications.en: Replaced the original initialize and validate steps with the Teloa creation flow: check for duplicates, then save a draft for confirmation.

modifications.zh-CN: 正文中的 Codex 改为中性的 the agent。
modifications.en: Replaced mentions of Codex with a neutral "the agent".

conditions.zh-CN: 只在本人普通会话中提供，同事执行任务时不可见。
conditions.en: Available only in your own ordinary conversations; not visible to colleagues running tasks.
